# MarketMitra

> A free, open-source financial dashboard for Indian markets (NSE): indices,
> stocks, fundamentals, news sentiment, IPOs, and AI insights. Built to serve
> both a human dashboard UI and a documented API surface an AI agent can call.
> All figures are public reference data — not investment advice.

## MCP server (recommended for agents)

MarketMitra exposes its read-only public data as an MCP server over
Streamable HTTP:

    https://marketmitra-v2.vercel.app/api/mcp

Client config: `{ "url": "https://marketmitra-v2.vercel.app/api/mcp" }`

Tools (all read-only, no auth; rate-limited):

- `search_symbols` — resolve a company name to an NSE trading symbol
- `get_quote` — batched live quotes (price, prev close, day change, 52w range)
- `get_company_fundamentals` — ratios, financial statements, shareholding,
  peers, annual-report links, business description
- `get_price_history` — daily OHLCV over 1mo / 6mo / 1y / 5y
- `get_news` — Indian-markets headlines; `sentiment` is rough headline tone,
  not analysis and not a signal
- `list_ipos` — IPO calendar, subscription, and unofficial grey-market
  premium (GMP is a third-party estimate, not an exchange figure)
- `get_market_indices` — NIFTY 50, SENSEX, NIFTY BANK, INDIA VIX

Resolve company names with `search_symbols` before calling the others.

## REST API

The dashboard's own HTTP endpoints (holdings, alerts, notifications, AI
insights, chat, search, news) are documented at:

    https://github.com/AnkushGitRepo/Financial-Dashboard/blob/main/docs/api-surface.md

Per-user endpoints require a Clerk session. The MCP server above is the
supported interface for automated/agent access to public data.

## Notes

- Data sourcing is free-only (no paid vendors). Some fields can be null when
  an upstream source came up short; every record carries a `source_tier`.
- MarketMitra has no paid tier. The hosted instance applies fair-use rate
  limits.
